name: Corporate retreats and incentives
short: An offsite with room to think, or a reward trip your team will talk about for years.
summary: An offsite with room to think, an incentive trip that feels earned, or a conference with a few good days around it.

image.alt: A lit café street inside Galle Fort at night

suits.heading: Work, and the time around it.
suits.body: We plan the logistics and the downtime so your team can concentrate on the reason they came.

services.heading: What we look after.
services.body: One point of contact from the first call to the last transfer.

items.title: Meeting spaces
items.body: Hotel meeting rooms, a tea-estate lawn or a heritage hall, with screens, sound and reliable internet.

items.title: Rooms for everyone
items.body: Room blocks in one hotel or several, with a rooming list we keep up to date.

items.title: Group transport
items.body: Coaches timed to flights, and smaller vehicles for leadership or guests.

items.title: The reward
items.body: A private dinner in Galle Fort, a safari morning, a cricket match, a cooking class.

items.title: On-site coordination
items.body: A coordinator with your group throughout, handling changes before anyone notices them.

items.title: Hill-country offsite
items.body: Meeting days in Kandy, an afternoon on a tea estate, and a dinner by the lake.

items.title: Coastal incentive
items.body: A resort on the south coast, a safari morning in Yala, and a gala night in Galle Fort.

items.title: Conference and extension
items.body: Your event in Colombo, with optional two- and three-night extensions for delegates.

questions.a: Yes. We send one quote and one invoice for the whole trip, in the currency you need.

questions.q: Can you handle a conference in Colombo?
questions.a: We arrange the venue, rooms, transport and the days around it. For large production, we work with your events agency.
